title: Mushroom Cheese Quiche
instructions: Bake the pie shells at 350°F for 10 minutes to set them.
Dice the onions and sauté them; add the mushrooms and continue sautéing 15-20 minutes.
Add the flour and stir well, then season with the salt and white pepper.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, milk, baking powder, and cheese.
Combine with the mushroom-onion mixture off the flame.
Pour into the baked pie shells. Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes, then top with the remaining cheese and bake 10 minutes more, until set and golden.

tips.title: Firmer filling
tips.text: You can use up to 1/3 cup flour for a firmer set.
